name: Coordinate Space Conversion
definition: Voxel space uses integer indices for direct access, while local/world spaces use floating-point coordinates. The center of voxel [0,0,0] is at floating-point coordinate [0.5, 0.5, 0.5].
summary: Coordinate Space Conversion maps world-space positions to voxel indices using deterministic arithmetic and tie-to-even rounding, differing from normalization by operating on physical units and integer grid topology.
